alt: Cherry blossom along a quiet canal in Osaka, Japan
transport: Shinkansen bullet train, private transfers and guided tours

program.name: Tokyo

program.name: Osaka
program.description: Three nights at a five star riverside hotel, with a day in Kyoto and Nara and a walking tour of the food streets.

Check in at your hotel in Hamamatsucho

Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens
Asakusa and the Senso-ji temple lanes

The fifth station on the mountain, weather permitting

Bullet train back into Tokyo in the evening

Shinkansen bullet train south to Osaka
Check in at the Imperial Hotel on the river
Rest of the day free for the two of you
5: Breakfast, then a full day out of Osaka
Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, on its pond
The deer park and Todai-ji temple in Nara

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Three simple nights in Tokyo, then three at the Imperial in Osaka. Spend the hotel money where you will actually sit still.
expert.tip: Ask for a river view room at the Imperial. The cherry trees along the Okawa are a five minute walk from the lobby in spring.

summary: Seven days for two: three nights in Tokyo with a city tour and a Mount Fuji day, then the bullet train to Osaka for three nights at the five star Imperial Hotel, with Kyoto, Nara and a walking tour of the food streets.
included: Included: 6 nights accommodation including three at the Imperial Hotel Osaka, with breakfast on the first four mornings; bullet train from Tokyo to Osaka; private airport transfers; full day Tokyo city tour; Mount Fuji and Hakone day trip; Kyoto and Nara day trip; Osaka half day walking tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
